::: {#rem-minimum-description-length-source}
#### Where the minimum description length principle comes from

@cover2006elements [section 14.13] state the principle
as the choice of the model such that the model's length
plus the length of the data given the model is as short as possible.
They give the model's length as its Kolmogorov complexity,
not as the length of a codeword from a [prefix code](huffman-codes.qmd#def-prefix-code).

:::
